name: fips205-slhdsa-esp32
description: SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) stateless hash-based post-quantum signatures for ESP32. All 12 parameter sets (SHA2/SHAKE, 128/192/256, s/f). Based on slhdsa-c with hardware RNG support, stack wiping and optional SHA hardware acceleration.
keywords: post-quantum, cryptography, digital-signature, slhdsa, sphincs, fips205, pqc, hash-based
